text:
Priya: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today

Priya: what I did: landed prefetch hotpatch on canary-2, added microbench harness for short sequences, ran a 50k-prime run vs master and collected traces.
Priya: blocker: observed KV cache hit-rate jitter on canary-3 and occasional mem spikes leading to OOM at high concurrency. need help triaging if it's prefetch window logic or GC pressure.
Priya: today: stabilize canary (add histograms, tighter alloc guards), coordinate a small rollback plan if OOMs persist, and open perf dashboards for the team.

Sam: saw the OOM earlier — canary-3 hit an OOM around 09:42UTC under ~300 clients. logs show repeated `oom_kv_chunk` and `alloc failure` lines.
Sam: short snippet from syslog: `2026-03-17T09:42:12Z kernel: force kill inference_worker[1823] pid=1823 oom_score_adj=0`

Anita: I'll grab the full canary logs and GC traces. Any repro command I can run locally?

Priya: repro script: `scripts/prime_kv.sh --clients 300 --seq 128 --duration 60`
Priya: sample prime output:
```
PRIME RUN: 50k reqs
p50 8ms p95 42ms p99 95ms
kv_hit 0.81
mem_rss 6.2G -> spikes to 9.8G
```

Leo: suggestion: temporarily drop prefetch window from 64->32 and enable `--async-evict` flag on canary to reduce peak resident set. I'll open a tiny PR with the config change.

Sam: good plan. if that reduces mem peak we can attribute to prefetch eagerness. if not, we'll look at allocator fragmentation.

perf-bot: nightly microbench finished (microbench/2026-03-17). Summary: short_seq p95 -9.8% vs master, kv_hit +3.2%. Artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/microbench/2026-03-17
perf-bot: full report uploaded to /s3/perf/reports/2026-03-17-microbench.html

Priya: plan: apply the config patch at 11:30 UTC to canary-3, re-run `prime_kv.sh` once patched, collect histograms + `jemalloc` stats, and post results here. will escalate to eng-sre if mem > 8G.

Anita: runbook snippet for rollback / mitigation (short):
1) scale canary down: `kubectl scale deploy/canary --replicas=1`
2) disable prefetch: edit ConfigMap `runtime-config.prefetch.window=0`
3) revert hotpatch PR: `gh pr revert <pr-number>`
4) notify eng-sre and attach `dmesg` + `heap_profile`

Leo: opened PR #4281 for prefetch window -> 32 + `--async-evict` flag. request review from @Sam and @Anita.

Sam: reviewing now, will add a brief smoke test job to CI to run `prime_kv.sh --clients 50 --seq 128` on every canary patch.

Priya: thanks — will post bench outputs here after the 11:30 patch. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: regression guard: p95_short_seq improved, but watch kv_hit variance on canary-3: stddev up 1.9%.

Anita: noted. grabbing logs now and will post a root-cause thread if I find GC/alloc pattern.

Priya: if anyone sees an alert, ping `@eng-sre` and link this thread.

Sam: ack.
